outputs.explanation: Panel A contains a bar chart of cell death (%) reported as mean±s.d. of three independent experiments, but no individual data points (dots) are overlaid on the bars.
Panel B contains a bar chart of cell death (%); only bars (presumably means) are shown with no individual data points overlaid, and no replicate information is given in the caption.
Panel C is a grouped bar chart showing mean±s.d. of three experiments at several time points for wt and null MEFs, but no individual data points are shown.

Panel D contains a bar chart of cell death (%) with error bars shown, but no individual data points are overlaid, and the caption does not indicate the number of replicates or that points represent individual measurements.
